intro: The Alpine recliner is our invitation to unwind. With a soft, floating seat feel, smooth manual reclining, and high back support, it wraps your body in comfort and your mind in stillness.

features.title: Recline with control, every time
features.text: With our smooth manual recliner, you’re always in charge of your comfort. Built with durable, noiseless metal linkages and tested for 158 kg, it’s designed to let you sit back, relax, and enjoy the moment.

features.title: Support that hugs your posture
features.text: You’ll feel the difference as soon as you lean back. The high backrest and integrated head support cradle your upper body, giving your spine the chance to reset and truly relax.

features.title: Softness that lifts you gently
features.text: Our seat cushions are made from high-resilience slab-stock foam and wrapped in plush polyester fibre. It’s soft, balanced, and supportive—just the way you want to feel at the end of your day.

features.title: Upholstery that keeps up with life
features.text: Life gets busy—your furniture shouldn’t show it. That’s why our cabinet uses abrasion-resistant synthetic leather that resists scratches, peeling and wear, while still feeling beautifully smooth to the touch.

features.title: Comfort that knows your body
features.text: We’ve added generous lumbar support and deeply padded armrests so your body feels truly looked after. Every inch of our recliner is designed to hold you in the comfort you deserve.

name: Alpine 2-Seater Synthetic Leather Manual Recliner Sofa
